subject: computer
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Tell data from information
Know the basic storage units: bits and bytes
Explain internal and external memory and what each is for
Name primary and secondary storage devices
Relate bits and bytes to the ON and OFF states of a digital system
Recall what the operating system and GUI do
Use the Task Bar, Quick Launch Bar and shortcut menu
Set the date, time and speaker volume
Customise the windows settings
Use editing tools: undo, redo, spell check, grammar check and thesaurus
Format text: font size, colour, bold, italics and underline
Change text alignment, line spacing and paragraph spacing
Use shortcut keys
Preview and print a document
Tell editing from formatting
Explain what a network is and what an internet connection needs
Label the parts of a browser window: address bar, refresh, home, back, forward, history, favourites, new tab and stop
Explain the terms www, URL, ISP and net surfing
Use a search engine with good keywords
Browse responsibly and follow netiquette
Explain the purpose of presentation software
Open and exit the software and name the parts of its window
Choose slide layouts to suit the task
Add text and images to slides
Insert slides, move between them and present a slide show
Explain reasoning and problem solving
Analyse a task and break it into simple steps
Predict possible ways to reach a goal
Plan a real task, such as a picnic or a birthday party
Copy and move a file or folder from one place to another
Rename and delete files and folders
Never tamper with other people's files or folders
